text: {"lessons":["I should not let the pain of realizing a loss keep me holding a stock; reassess each position using its current outlook and risk, not my average cost.","Taking a gain feels good, but selling simply to lock in profit can cut short further upside; use a consistent plan for sizing and exits.","A few periods and trades are not enough to prove a strategy works, so I should stay diversified and judge decisions over time rather than react to short-term swings."]}
